page_title: NOT 2-1 MNU | Nottingham Forest v Manchester Utd 30/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+11' That's it for today, Tim Robinson has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+9' Christian Eriksen (Manchester United) goes in the referee's notebook after being shown a yellow card.
90+8' Some great play by Amad Diallo (Manchester United) ends with a shot on the edge of the box towards the middle of the goal, but Matt Turner sees it all the way and makes a comfortable save.
90+7' Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) makes a run beyond the last defender, but he's offside.
90+6' A dangerous looking corner kick from Christian Eriksen (Manchester United) is cleared to safety by the defence.

90+6' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) receives a cross on the edge of the box. He doesn't hesitate and fires a bullet towards the goal. Nevertheless, the goalkeeper had no trouble dealing with his shot. Manchester Utd have been awarded a corner kick.
90+5' Christian Eriksen (Manchester United) takes the corner.
90+4' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
90+3' The game is interrupted now, Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
90+3' The Manchester Utd players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
90' We will have 10 min. of added time.
90' Today's match ends for Aaron Wan-Bissaka who will be replaced by Sergio Reguilon (Manchester United).
89' Matt Turner comes off his line to intercept the corner from Christian Eriksen (Manchester United).
88' Orel Mangala (Nottingham) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
87' Nuno Espirito Santo prepares a substitution. Anthony Elanga is replaced by Willy Boly (Nottingham).
87' Nuno Espirito Santo decides to make a substitution. Danilo will be replaced by Orel Mangala (Nottingham).
87' Here comes a substitution. Harry Toffolo (Nottingham) is brought on as a substitute for Ola Aina.
85' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
82' 2 - 1 Goal! Anthony Elanga tees up Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) on the edge of the box and he fires the ball into the right side of the goal. 2:1.
82' Christian Eriksen (Manchester United) releases a decent shot towards the middle of the goal from the edge of the box, but it's comfortably gathered by Matt Turner.
79' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) is coming onto the pitch as Nicolas Dominguez cannot continue after picking up an injury.
78' 1 - 1 Goal! Alejandro Garnacho pulls the ball back for Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) on the edge of the box, and he beats the keeper with a fine strike into the bottom right corner. 1:1.
76' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) commits a foul and Tim Robinson immediately signals a free kick.
75' Ryan Yates (Nottingham) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
74' Nuno Espirito Santo has decided to substitute Gonzalo Montiel and he is replaced by Neco Williams (Nottingham).
73' Ryan Yates (Nottingham) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
72' Christian Eriksen (Manchester United) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Matt Turner intercepts the ball.
71' Nottingham are awarded a free kick near the side line and the players make their way into the box for the inevitable cross.
70' Raphael Varane (Manchester United) sends a long ball in, but Matt Turner comfortably gathers the ball.
67' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) receives a fine cross inside the box and attempts to score a goal, but his strike flies just a few inches over the bar.
67' The referee awards a corner and Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) goes over to take it.

64' 1 - 0 Goal! Nicolas Dominguez (Nottingham) neatly controls a decent pass from Gonzalo Montiel. He looks up and smashes an unstoppable drive into the left side of the goal from the edge of the box. 1:0.
63' Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
62' Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
59' Nottingham are awarded a mid-range free kick.
59' Raphael Varane (Manchester United) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
57' That's a clear yellow card. Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) goes into the book.
56' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.

56' OFF THE POST! Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) runs towards the goal to give his teammate support. He receives a fantastic pass and shoots from the edge of the box, but it crashes against the right post. It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky.
54' The substitution has been made. Amad Diallo (Manchester United) has replaced Antony.
54' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
53' Ola Aina (Nottingham) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball.
51' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
50' PENALTY APPEAL by Nottingham, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
48' A pass by Christian Eriksen (Manchester United) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
46' Erik ten Hag has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Scott McTominay comes on the pitch for Kobbie Mainoo (Manchester United).
46' Tim Robinson blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
44' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) attempts to find a teammate with the corner, but the effort is snuffed out by the goalkeeper.
41' Nottingham will look to benefit from a promising free kick near the touchline.
39' Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) sends an accurate pass to Bruno Fernandes, who controls the ball with a fine first touch.
36' The ball possession is 49:51.
33' Aaron Wan-Bissaka (Manchester United) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
32' Ryan Yates (Nottingham) controls a great pass from Anthony Elanga on the edge of the box, steadies himself but his poor effort goes yards over the bar.
28' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) sends a long ball forward to Nicolas Dominguez, but he put too much power and the chance is gone.
27' Danilo (Nottingham) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
26' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
25' Jonny Evans (Manchester United) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.
22' Aaron Wan-Bissaka (Manchester United) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
21' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Nottingham.
19' Tim Robinson blows his whistle and it's Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
17' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
14' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) tries to find Antony, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
12' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
11' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) takes the corner but it's cleared.
10' Gonzalo Montiel (Nottingham) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. Nottingham win a corner.
8' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
7' Chris Wood (Nottingham) fires the ball towards goal from just outside the penalty area, but it goes narrowly over the crossbar after coming very close to hitting the roof of the net.
5' A crossfield pass from Matt Turner (Nottingham) fails to find any of his teammates.
4' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
2' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
1' The first half has started.
Nottingham will kick the game off.
Today's referee will be Tim Robinson.
